auto_merge.commit_message:
Some optimised dictionary getter methods return either a value of the dict value type or a default value with arbitrary object type. Therefore, inferring the value type is incorrect and leads to incorrect C code being generated.

Fixes https://github.com/cython/cython/issues/7991
auto_merge.commit_title: Fix handling default values in typed dictionaries (GH-8003)

```suggestion
def find_return_type_of_builtin_method(pos, env, builtin_type, method_name, args=None) -> tuple[PyrexTypes.PyrexType, bool]:
    # Returns a tuple: (return type, may be None)
```
Alternatively, we could use a named enum for the flag to make it readable, but frankly, it's sad that there is no type that explicitly says "builtin type or None". I'd keep it to a comment for now.

comment_data.body:
If the method is called with an unexpected number of arguments, I don't think we should make assumptions about the return type.
```suggestion
                if len(args) > 2:
                    # Unusual call, possibly a runtime error.
                    return PyrexTypes.py_object_type, True
                # Method called with 'default' parameter.
                default_type = args[1].type or args[1].infer_type(env)
                return_type = PyrexTypes.independent_spanning_type(return_type, default_type)
                return return_type, return_type is PyrexTypes.py_object_type
```

to
